name: files
title: Files
description: Find files by name or contents through the system's search index, browse folders, and act on files: open, reveal, Quick Look, rename, move, compress or trash. Recent files show before you type, and on macOS what you selected in Finder.
author: pal

settings.label: Results
settings.description: At most this many rows per query.

settings.label: Hidden files
settings.text: List files and folders whose name starts with a dot

settings.label: Search contents
settings.text: Also list files whose text contains the query, under the name matches (a query starting with ' or content: searches contents only)

settings.label: OCR copies are private
settings.text: Text read from an image (Copy text) is kept out of clipboard history

settings.label: Exclude
settings.description: Folders skipped below the search folders, by name (`node_modules`) or a short path (`Library/Caches`).

settings.label: Terminal
settings.description: What Open in Terminal opens: `Terminal` (default), `iTerm`, `kitty`, `Alacritty`, `WezTerm`, `Ghostty`, or any app name (`open -na <name> --args -e ...`); on Linux a command name (`kitty`, `foot`, `alacritty`, `wezterm`, `ghostty`, ...), else `$TERMINAL`, else the first of those installed.

store.tagline: Find, browse and act on files, recent ones before you type
features: Search by name through Spotlight on macOS or `fd`/`locate` on Linux; by contents with a `'` prefix
Recent files and the Finder selection before you type anything
`enter` on a folder browses it, sorted by name, date or size
Open with, reveal, Quick Look, copy the path or file, open in a terminal
Rename, move, copy, compress or trash, one file or several at once
Copy the text out of an image or PDF (`cmd+shift+t`)

screenshots.caption: Part of a file name typed: the matches under the configured folders, size and date on the right
The detail pane on a text file: path, size, modified, kind, and its first lines
Open with…: the apps registered for the file, the default tagged
Recent Files: what was used in the last seven days, newest first
Browsing ~/proj: the crumb is the folder, .. leads, the dropdown sorts by name, date or size
Rename (cmd+shift+R) is a form over the name, in the same folder; Move to and Copy to open the same way

actions.title: Browse
actions.description: On a folder: its contents as a level, `→` too. `←` or Backspace goes up.

actions.title: Reveal in Finder
actions.description: Show in file manager on Linux.

actions.title: Quick Look
actions.description: macOS only; every marked row at once, arrows between them.

actions.title: Open with…
actions.description: A level of the apps registered for the file.

actions.title: Copy file
actions.description: The file itself onto the clipboard: a paste in Finder copies it.

actions.title: Open in Terminal
actions.description: A terminal window in the folder (a file's folder), the app the `terminal` setting names.

actions.title: Rename
actions.description: The name typed in the bar, in the same folder; a form with the current name when blank.

actions.title: Move to…
actions.description: A form; the folder it goes to, made when missing.

actions.title: Copy to…
actions.description: A form; a copy under the same name in that folder.

actions.title: Compress
actions.description: A zip next to the file, or one zip of every marked row, named after the first.

actions.title: Show hidden files
actions.description: In a browsed folder: flips the `show_hidden` setting.

files.title: Files
files.description: Type part of a file name; rows are the matches under the configured folders. Before you type: the recently used files. A path (`~/Down`, `/usr/local`) lists the file or its completions, at the root too, and a path ending in `/` lists that folder whole; Enter on a folder browses it. A root query nothing matched gets a Search Files fallback row.

keys.title: Open the file, browse a folder
Rename to the name typed in the bar

browse.title: Browse Folder
browse.description: A folder's contents, pushed by Browse on a folder row (or by typing a path ending in `/`): a `..` row first, then the entries under the dropdown's sort (name, date, size), hidden ones with `show_hidden`, at most 500. The crumb is the folder; typing filters by name.

keys.title: Browse a folder, open a file
Browse the folder under the cursor
Cycle the sort: name, date, size
Rename to the name typed in the bar

selection.title: Finder Selection
selection.description: The files selected in Finder (the front window's, or the Desktop's), each with the file actions; several are led by an "N items" row whose actions run on all of them. The same rows lead the empty root under "Selected in Finder" whenever pal opens over Finder with something marked. macOS only; the palette says why when Finder is not in front or nothing is selected.

keys.title: Open the file, browse a folder
Rename to the name typed in the bar

recent.title: Recent Files
recent.description: Files used in the last seven days under the configured folders, newest first.
